title: Here’s How to Get MGM+ Online for Free
summary: Thinking about joining MGM+? Here's the best way to score access for free.
contentText:

The best way to test out MGM+ is with a free trial to the streaming service. You’d want to see if it’s a good fit before you commit month-to-month. The service is the home to hit originals, like From , Godfather of Harlem , Billy the Kid , American Hostage and others, as well as hot music programming, such as Words + Music: John Legend , New Wave , San Francisco Sounds: A Place in Time , and In Restless Dreams: The Music of Paul Simon .

Get MGM+ 7-day Free Trial on Prime Video

Although the streaming service no longer offers a free trial directly, we spotted a clever workaround to get access for free.

You can get MGM+ for free, as a Prime Video add-on channel . The streamer has a seven-day free trial to give the MGM+ plan a test drive before you commit to the service. Just add MGM+ to Prime Video and you’re all set to watch for free.

MGM+

Get Starz

Afterward, MGM+, which gives you access to a wide range of TV shows and movies, goes for $7.99 per month. After the free trial ends, your plan will automatically renew at the regular rate.

Starz on MGM+

Get Starz on Philo

Meanwhile, MGM+ is offered as an add-on with Philo with a seven-day free trial . After the free trial is finished, MGM+ on Philo goes for $7.99 per month (in addition to Philo Essential’s $25 per month).

Philo comes with more than 70 cable networks, such as AMC, A&E, Animal Planet, BBC America, BET, Cartoon Network, CMT, Comedy Central, Discovery Channel, EarthX, Food Network, Game Show Network, Hallmark Channel, HGTV, History Channel, Investigation Discovery, IFC, Lifetime, Logo, MTV, MotorTrends, Nickelodeon, OWN, Paramount Network, Pop TV, Revolt, Smithsonian Channel, Sundance TV, TLC, UPtv, VH1, and Vice. Learn more about Philo here .

MGM+ is the home to hit originals, like Treasure Island , A Tale of Two Cities , SAS: Rogue Heroes , Earth Abides , Robin Hood , and Beacon 23 .

The streaming service has a large number of movies too, including Challengers , Project Hail Mary , The Running Man , Cold Storage , The Naked Gun (2025), Deep Water , Nickel Boys , The Godfather , and Fargo .
